Sun Art Retail Group is a Hong Kong-listed Chinese hypermarket operator, running RT-Mart and Auchan hypermarkets across China, with hundreds of stores. Alibaba Group took control in 2020 and later agreed to sell it to DCP Capital in 2025 for about 1.6 billion dollars. It sells groceries and general merchandise to mass-market consumers. It is a well known consumer retail brand in China.

Sunac China Holdings is a Chinese property developer, listed in Hong Kong (1918), which has residential projects across China and had a big presence in Tianjin. It has been in a major debt crisis since 2021, defaulted on offshore bonds and has been restructuring its debts. It once owned stakes in Leshi (LeEco) and Wanda's tourism assets. It is a household name for Chinese homebuyers, and is a distressed company with significant financial risk.

Taylor Morrison Home Corporation is a Scottsdale, Arizona homebuilder, designing, building and selling single-family and multi-family homes under Taylor Morrison and Esplanade (active adult and resort-lifestyle) brands in around 10 US states, including Texas, Florida, Arizona, Colorado and California. It also has a mortgage arm. It delivers about 12,000 homes a year, revenue near 8 billion dollars, and is listed on the NYSE (TMHC). It is a recognised consumer homebuilding brand in the US.

Tishman Speyer is a New York based real estate developer, owner and operator of offices, residential, retail and mixed-use projects around the world, including Rockefeller Center, which it owns, the Chrysler Building previously and projects across Europe, Asia and Latin America. Founded in 1978 and led by Rob Speyer, it manages tens of billions of dollars of assets and runs investment funds. It is private. It is a prominent B2B real estate brand with a visible presence in global cities.

TopBuild is a Daytona Beach, Florida installer and distributor of insulation and building products, serving residential and commercial builders through TruTeam installation and Specialty Distribution businesses, which it expanded by acquiring Specialty Products & Insulation and Progressive Roofing. It is listed on the NYSE (BLD), with revenue of about 5 billion dollars. Customers are builders and contractors. It is a B2B brand, which has done limited sports sponsorship, with little consumer awareness.

Toys R Us Spain is the Spanish arm of the Toys R Us toy retail brand, based in Madrid, which sells toys, games and children's products through stores and online. The US parent went bankrupt in 2017-2018, and the international rights are held by licensees. Who operates the Spanish stores today should be checked. It is a recognised consumer toy brand in Spain. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Tullow Oil is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company based in London (the record lists Chiswick), with producing assets in Ghana (Jubilee and TEN fields), Gabon, Cote d'Ivoire and Kenya exploration. It sells crude to traders and refiners and has been reducing debt after production problems. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange (TLW) and Ghana Stock Exchange. It is a B2B energy producer with limited consumer awareness.

United Site Services is the largest US provider of portable toilets, temporary fencing, restroom trailers and site services, based in Meridian, Idaho (it also operated from Atlanta), serving construction sites, events, and municipalities with branches nationwide. It is private equity owned by Platinum Equity, which acquired it in 2017 and formed it by merging regional providers. It operates a large fleet of units and trucks. It is a B2B service brand visible at events and construction sites.

VTG is a Hamburg based European rail logistics and wagon-hire company, which owns and leases a fleet of about 90,000 railcars, plus tank containers and a rail logistics arm, for the chemical, oil, agri and automotive industries. It is owned by Warburg Pincus and Morgan Stanley Infrastructure after a 2017-2018 takeover, and delisted from the stock market. Funding shown is about 2.9 billion euros. It is a B2B rail asset company with no consumer brand awareness.

Assemblin Caverion Group is a Stockholm based Nordic and European building services and technical services group, formed in 2024 when Assemblin merged with Caverion, offering installation, maintenance and facility services for HVAC, electrical, plumbing and building automation. It is owned by private equity firm Triton, which bought Caverion and combined it with Assemblin, and Caverion was delisted from Helsinki. It has around 15,000 employees and revenue near 5 billion euros. It is a B2B services brand with little consumer awareness.
